# An escaping region use in a Go package falls back to the heap with a
# perf::arena_fallback diagnostic, never a correctness::region_escape error.
env GOPROXY=off
env GOTOOLCHAIN=local
env GOEXPERIMENT=logosarena

cd m
logos lint .
stderr 'main\.go:13:21: warning: \[perf::arena_fallback\] arena\.New\[int\].*falls back to the heap: value reaches global'
! stderr 'region_escape'
logos lint --json-diagnostics .
stderr '"rule_id":"perf::arena_fallback"'
stderr '"severity":"warn"'
stderr 'value reaches global'
logos build .
stderr 'main\.go:13:21: warning: \[perf::arena_fallback\] arena\.New\[int\].*value reaches global'
! stderr 'region_escape'
logos build -gcflags=-m .
stderr 'main\.go:.*region fallback: value reaches global'
stderr 'perf::arena_fallback'
! stderr 'region_escape'
go build -gcflags=-m .
stderr 'main\.go:.*region fallback: value reaches global'
! stderr 'perf::arena_fallback'
! stderr 'region_escape'
logos vet .
go vet .
logos run .
stdout '^42$'
go run .

# A returned region object falls back with the call position and flow.
cd ../ret
logos lint .
stderr 'main\.go:10:21: warning: \[perf::arena_fallback\] arena\.New\[int\].*falls back to the heap: value reaches'
! stderr 'region_escape'
logos build .
stderr 'perf::arena_fallback'
! stderr 'region_escape'
go build -gcflags=-m .
stderr 'main\.go:.*region fallback: value reaches'
! stderr 'perf::arena_fallback'
! stderr 'region_escape'

# A region object sent on a channel falls back with the call position.
cd ../chan
logos lint .
stderr 'main\.go:11:21: warning: \[perf::arena_fallback\] arena\.New\[int\].*falls back to the heap: value reaches'
! stderr 'region_escape'
logos build .
stderr 'perf::arena_fallback'
! stderr 'region_escape'
go build -gcflags=-m .
stderr 'main\.go:.*region fallback: value reaches'
! stderr 'perf::arena_fallback'
! stderr 'region_escape'

# A local region object stays silent: lint reports nothing, the build
# places it in the region with no fallback diagnostic.
cd ../non
logos lint .
! stderr 'arena_fallback'
! stderr 'region_escape'
logos build -gcflags=-m .
stderr 'main\.go:.*placed in region'
! stderr 'arena_fallback'
! stderr 'region fallback: value reaches'
go build -gcflags=-m .
stderr 'main\.go:.*placed in region'
! stderr 'arena_fallback'

# Placement stays off without the experiment. The off directory holds
# a non-escaping use: with the experiment plain go places it in the
# region, without it both commands keep it on the heap with no
# placement diagnostic and identical output.
cd ../off
env GOEXPERIMENT=logosarena
go build -gcflags=-m .
stderr 'main\.go:.*placed in region'
! stderr 'region_escape'
env GOEXPERIMENT=
logos build -gcflags=-m .
! stderr 'placed in region'
! stderr 'region_escape'
logos run .
stdout '^42$'
go build -gcflags=-m .
! stderr 'placed in region'
! stderr 'region_escape'
go run .
stdout '^42$'

-- m/go.mod --
module example.com/arenagofallback

go 1.27

-- m/main.go --
package main

import (
	"fmt"

	"logos/arena"
)

var saved *int

func main() {
	r := arena.Open()
	p := arena.New[int](r)
	*p = 42
	saved = p
	fmt.Println(*saved)
	_ = r
}

-- ret/go.mod --
module example.com/arenagofallbackret

go 1.27

-- ret/main.go --
package main

import (
	"fmt"

	"logos/arena"
)

func makePtr(r arena.Region) *int {
	p := arena.New[int](r)
	*p = 7
	return p
}

func main() {
	r := arena.Open()
	q := makePtr(r)
	fmt.Println(*q)
	_ = r
}

-- chan/go.mod --
module example.com/arenagofallbackchan

go 1.27

-- chan/main.go --
package main

import (
	"fmt"

	"logos/arena"
)

func main() {
	r := arena.Open()
	p := arena.New[int](r)
	*p = 9
	ch := make(chan *int, 1)
	ch <- p
	fmt.Println(*<-ch)
	_ = r
}

-- non/go.mod --
module example.com/arenagofallbacknon

go 1.27

-- non/main.go --
package main

import (
	"fmt"

	"logos/arena"
)

func main() {
	r := arena.Open()
	p := arena.New[int](r)
	*p = 41
	fmt.Println(*p + 1)
	_ = r
}

-- off/go.mod --
module example.com/arenagooff

go 1.27

-- off/logos.toml --
[build]
arena = false

-- off/main.go --
package main

import (
	"fmt"

	"logos/arena"
)

func main() {
	r := arena.Open()
	p := arena.New[int](r)
	*p = 41
	fmt.Println(*p + 1)
	_ = r
}
